author: Smoebo
source: Generated with the Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60 (image_gen), one image per prompt, as original designs. The 1024x1024 JPEG originals are kept outside the repository; their hashes are below.
encoding: Each original resized once to 256x256 (fit: cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp 0.35.5 (libvips 8.18.7). No other edit.
use: Drawn only for a revealed enemy of that name in that genre (REVEALED_ENEMY_PLATES in src/lib/placeholders.ts), where the stat block's own plate is the wrong picture: the mimic's is a treasure chest, and cyberpunk and the wasteland explain their monsters with science.
subjectBasis: Original designs for named SRD 5.1 creatures (mimic, rakshasa, vampire, wererat) as each genre's bestiary presents them, per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md. No Product Identity subject appears; each image was inspected at full size for its anatomy as well as its prompt.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed in a round crop at 96px and 40px on a dark and a light surround, per docs/art/token-readability.md.

plates.subject: The Wrong Door revealed (horror, fights as the SRD mimic)
plates.basis: an original mimic in the shape of a house door: a named SRD 5.1 creature (mimic) in a form the SRD describes it taking, not a published illustration
plates.prompt: A monstrous mimic in the shape of an old wooden house door, the door split open into a huge fanged mouth with a long purple tongue, the wood grain stretched like flesh, the brass knob become a staring eye, sticky strands between the teeth. Square 1:1 role-playing game token portrait. Highly detailed dramatic digital painting in the style of dark fantasy game art, crisp focal detail, saturated colour, strong contrast. The door monster fills the frame from top to bottom, the mouth centred. Plain painterly backdrop of faded green wallpaper that runs flat to every edge and corner of the square image with no vignette and no round shape, lighter than the subject, with no scenery. One identifying cue only. The subject's outline must stand out clearly from the backdrop. Must read clearly as a 40 pixel round token. Full square image, no border, no circular frame, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo. Original design, not a likeness of any real person, film character or published illustration.
